description:
modules/traegerview — GET /traeger/schools/alerts (#4675): the Träger
row, the school IDs of the Träger, the school rows, the six figure reads
of /today (two rosters, presence, sick days, sick flags, on-site staff)
and the waiting enrollment children for the whole school set in one
administrative transaction, then the Träger transaction scope and the
Träger's threshold values. Flat in the number of schools.
